name: Mermaid CLI

field_reviews.reason: mermaid-cli is an MIT-licensed npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) run locally via mmdc; the README documents no credentials, accounts, or auth of any kind.
Install via npm/Docker and run locally; no authentication exists anywhere in the tool.
npmjs.com/package/@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli confirms MIT license, public npm distribution (v11.16.0, ~517k weekly downloads), plus Docker images; anyone can install and run with no account.

The GitHub README describes only a local CLI (mmdc) converting mermaid definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF and a local Node.JS API ('not covered by semver'); there is no hosted endpoint of any kind in the mermaid-js/mermaid-cli project.

No network protocol is exposed by mermaid-cli itself. The draft correctly excludes mermaid.ink (a third-party service by jihchi, not the mermaid-js org) and Mermaid Chart's hosted offerings, which are distinct products.

mermaid-cli itself ships no MCP. The Mermaid Chart team (mermaid.ai, the commercial product from the Mermaid maintainers) hosts an official remote MCP at https://mcp.mermaid.ai/mcp documented at mermaid.ai/docs/ai/mcp-server; core validation/rendering tools work without authentication, account-integration tools require a Mermaid Chart API token. Classifying it as an official platform/adjacent-product MCP rather than a vendor MCP for the OSS CLI is correct. Independently confirmed docs.composio.dev/toolkits/mermaid.md returns 404 - no Composio toolkit.

As an API-integration target, mermaid-cli offers no hosted API to build against - it is a local binary/library. Re-checked for any official mermaid-js hosted rendering API and found none: mermaid.ink is third-party (jihchi) and Mermaid Chart is a separate commercial product. The draft's not_buildable / no-hosted-API framing is right for this row.
The only 'blocker' is that the tool runs locally with no remote surface, exactly as stated.

notes: Re-checked github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli and the npm package page (both opened directly, including the draft's evidence URLs): local CLI (mmdc) rendering mermaid to SVG/PNG/PDF, MIT, npm/Docker install, local Node.JS API only, no hosted service and no auth. Searched for an official hosted API: mermaid.ink is third-party open source (jihchi), and the hosted MCP at mcp.mermaid.ai/mcp belongs to Mermaid Chart (mermaid.ai), the maintainers' separate commercial product - confirmed via mermaid.ai/docs/ai/mcp-server, which matches the draft's description (core tools auth-free, account tools need a Mermaid Chart token). Composio mermaid toolkit 404 re-confirmed. All eight fields hold.
